wages.text: Ford says he supports raising and indexing the federal minimum wage and strengthening collective bargaining.
wages.quote: I support raising the federal minimum wage and indexing it to inflation through legislation such as the Raise the Wage Act, alongside policies that strengthen collective bargaining

trade.text: Ford criticized the recent tariff-heavy approach as a hidden tax on consumers that did not deliver gains at home.
trade.quote: The tariff-heavy approach of recent years acted as a hidden tax on consumers without delivering durable gains at home.

debt.text: Ford says he supports expanding and strengthening Social Security so seniors can age with dignity.
debt.quote: I support expanding and strengthening Social Security through legislation such as the Social Security Expansion Act, so seniors can age with dignity.

housing.text: Ford says he supports expanding the supply of affordable homes through federal housing legislation.
housing.quote: I support expanding the supply of affordable homes through the Affordable Housing Credit Improvement Act

immigration.text: Ford expressed deep concern about the Operation Midway Blitz federal immigration enforcement operation and how it was carried out.
immigration.quote: I am deeply concerned about Operation Midway Blitz and how it was carried out.

guns.text: Ford, a Giffords-endorsed firearm task force chair, backs responsible firearm laws and enforcement against gun trafficking.
guns.quote: responsible firearm laws, stronger enforcement against illegal gun trafficking, and investments in community violence prevention

health.text: Ford says he supports legislation to reduce out-of-pocket costs and protect coverage, including ACA subsidy expansion.
health.quote: To lower health care costs, I support legislation that reduces out-of-pocket expenses and protects coverage, including the Lower Drug Costs Now Act and the ACA Subsidy Expansion and Protection Act.

voting.text: Ford says he supports voting rights and election protection legislation to ensure fair ballot access.
voting.quote: I support comprehensive voting rights and election protection legislation, including the Freedom to Vote Act and the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, to ensure fair access to the ballot and to prevent discriminatory practices.

tax.text: Koppie calls high federal tax rates the most pressing issue and campaigns on large spending cuts paired with cuts to tax rates.
tax.quote: He also supports large spending cuts and tax rate cuts.

debt.text: Koppie argues the national debt and deficit harm the economy and calls for large cuts in federal spending.
debt.quote: An out of control national debt & deficit oppresses the economy and prevents economic growth.

immigration.text: Koppie supports building a border wall and says ICE should arrest and deport people in the country illegally.
immigration.quote: Chad supports building the wall along the Mexican border. He says that ICE should try to arrest and deport all illegal aliens.

guns.text: Koppie backs Second Amendment gun rights and says he will never vote for gun control bills.
guns.quote: Chad supports the 2nd Amendment. He knows that law-abiding Americans can own guns to defend themselves.

abortion.text: Koppie says a main goal of his campaign is to ban abortion, and he has proposed a constitutional amendment declaring that human life begins at conception.
abortion.quote: Like in previous campaigns, his main goal is trying to ban abortion.

health.text: Koppie describes himself as a free-market advocate on health care who wants the government to protect individual freedom of choice.
health.quote: As a free-market advocate, I believe the government should protect the freedom to choose
